researchNotes: Official site (montaleparfums.com) read: collection listing pages (Mystical Escape, Garden of Eden, Wild Refuge, Sweet Reverie, Ocean Breeze, Solar Mirage, Land of Conquest) and the official product pages. The Mystical Escape collection (28 perfumes) is covered in full, plus a selection of other Montale perfumes; the catalogue is partial (roughly 100 unique perfumes are listed across collections). Gift sets, discovery sets, body care and candles are excluded. Concentration is Eau de Parfum on the pages read. Perfumer and release year are not stated, so they are null. Family values are the breadcrumb category on the product page. Brand country is not stated on the pages read.

fragrances.name: Attar

sources.name: The Fandomentals — Montale's Attar showcases elegance and power
Scents Angel — Montale Attar Eau de parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewer: moderate sillage, excellent projection, about nine hours on skin; Fandomentals: an all-day perfume with very strong performance; Scents Angel listing: 10+ hours, strong sillage, best in fall/winter and evenings.

fragrances.name: Aoud Queen Roses

sources.name: Basenotes — Aoud Queen Roses by Montale reviews
FragranceX — Montale Aoud Queen Roses Perfume

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Basenotes reviewer: sillage moderate throughout, longevity can reach 10 hours (rose fades after about 7); FragranceX: moderately strong sillage, cool-weather scent, suited to a special evening.

fragrances.name: Aoud Musk
fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX and Perfume.com: lasts about 8-12 hours; Perfume.com: best in fall and winter; Scento guide: exceptional longevity, strong sillage, lingers into the next day.

fragrances.name: Dallachai

sources.name: Scent Verdict — Montale Dallachai Eau de Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: 6-8 hours on skin, moderate projection, moderate-to-strong sillage, best in fall and winter; Scent Verdict: lasts about 6-10 hours and fills a room.

fragrances.name: Beast Love

sources.name: MaxAroma — Montale Beast Love Eau de Parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: MaxAroma listing: long-lasting with strong projection, for evenings and nights in fall-winter; CaFleureBon: Montale-style sillage and 'beast mode' longevity (Notino instead says it stays close to the skin).

Scents Angel — Montale Wood On Fire Eau de parfum
Duft-Tagebuch — Dark Vanilla and Wood on Fire by Montale

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir review: moderate sillage and projection, about 8-12 h reported; Scents Angel and FragranceX: 8-10 / 8-12 hours; Duft-Tagebuch blog: medium presence, excellent durability, for cooler weather and evenings.

fragrances.name: Oud Edition

Art of Sense — Montale Oud Edition

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 8-10+ hours, strong projection, fall/winter evening wear; FragranceX: 8-10+ hours, projects generously, cooler months; Art of Sense listing rates longevity 4/5 and sillage 3/5.

fragrances.name: Oud Pashmina

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 8-10 hours, moderate-to-strong sillage; mamuse: all-day 8+ hours, strong sillage, winter/evening; LaBellePerfumes: pronounced sillage, winter or evening wear.

fragrances.name: Oud Tobacco

Notino — Montale Oud Tobacco customer reviews

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 10+ hours, strong projection in the first 3-4 h, cool weather and evenings; Notino buyers: lasts a full day, even next day, high projection, winter scent; Perfume Oasis lists only 5-7 h.

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Vivir EDP review: 10-12+ hours, strong early projection, heavy trail; Ottaviano listing: high sillage and persistence; Notino: for fall and winter evenings.

Scents Angel — Montale Oud Dream Eau de parfum
Fragrance Scents Joy — Montale Perfume Review

Basenotes — Vetiver Patchouli by Montale reviews
Scents Angel — Montale Vetiver Patchouli Eau de parfum

fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX: lasts 8-10 hours with significant sillage, best in fall/winter and evening; Perfume.com: 8-12 hours, designed for night and cold seasons; Vivir review rates it 4.5/5 longevity.

fragrances.performanceEvidence: FragranceX buyer: 12+ hours, strong projection about 4 h; Scentira: 10-12 hours, strong sillage; Vivir review: 8-12 h, heavy sillage, fall/winter evenings and date nights.

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Scents Angel: 10-12 hours, strong sillage, made for night and colder months; FragranceX and Perfume.com: 8-12 hours or more; a FragranceX buyer says it projects well all day.

Now Smell This — Montale White Aoud fragrance review

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Kafkaesque blog test: strong sillage for about two hours then skin scent, lasted nearly 15 hours; Basenotes commenters: huge projection, 12h+; a FragranceX buyer finds sillage modest, about 2 ft; FragranceX lists 8-10 hours.

sources.name: Basenotes — Reviews of Full Incense by Montale

fragrances.name: Dark Purple

fragrances.performanceEvidence: Perfume.com: 8-10 hours, strong sillage; mamuse: 8+ hours, room-noticeable, winter evenings and date nights; The Last Spritz: 8-10 h, strong trail, best in fall at night.

fragrances.name: Amber & Spices
fragrances.performanceEvidence: One Basenotes reviewer: moderate sillage, good projection, about twelve hours on skin, an autumnal scent (single review; no retailer figures found).
